title: 80 Leeson Street Upper, Ballsbridge, Dublin 4
description:
Lisney Sotheby’s International Realty are delighted to present this exceptional Victorian residence, comprehensively refurbished to an outstanding standard. Occupying a prime position on prestigious Upper Leeson Street, this magnificent home seamlessly blends timeless period elegance with bespoke contemporary design, creating a truly remarkable residence in the heart of Dublin 4.

Extending to approximately 240 sq.m. (2,583 sq.ft.), the property retains a wealth of original period features, including magnificent ceiling cornicing, original sash windows and beautifully proportioned reception rooms, while benefiting from an extensive, no-expense-spared refurbishment throughout.

At the heart of the home is a bespoke handcrafted kitchen featuring dovetail cabinetry, Calacatta Brazil natural quartzite worktops and a premium suite of appliances, including a Lacanche range cooker, Liebherr fridge freezer, Quooker boiling water tap, Miele dishwasher and Miele microwave. Bespoke fitted joinery, engineered timber flooring by Trunk Flooring, designer lighting from Soho Home, Heathfield & Co. and Hector Finch, together with a carefully curated palette of Farrow & Ball and Paint & Paper Library colours, further enhance the exceptional specification. Elegant gas fireplaces feature in the kitchen, dining room and sitting room, complemented by an electric fireplace in the den.

The landscaped rear garden has been thoughtfully designed for outdoor entertaining, complete with a bespoke BBQ area with a dedicated gas supply. Modern conveniences include a monitored G4S alarm system, CCTV and luxury fixtures and fittings throughout.

Perfectly positioned just moments from Donnybrook Village, Herbert Park, Ballsbridge and Dublin city centre, with an exceptional selection of cafÃ©s, restaurants, sporting amenities and excellent transport links on the doorstep, this is a rare opportunity to acquire a turnkey period residence of exceptional quality on one of Dublin 4’s most sought-after addresses.
